L09_portus_lighthouse.notes: Warm stone walls; lowest foot is sea_base. The existing summit/conical roof and balcony top faces are sea_cap. Small inset shaft-window faces use sea_recess, bounded by measured recess depth, window heights and face area to exclude broad outer walls. Lantern body remains stone.

L09_portus_mole.notes: Raised quay wall body remains warm stone. Low vertical/underside foundation faces use sea_base; actual upward-facing recessed floor and perimeter walking surface use sea_deck; the elevated corner-block top uses sea_cap. Irregular debris remains stone.

L12_harbor_pilae.notes: Six existing pier/pillar forms: stone side walls, sea_base below the slab-top elevation, sea_deck on actual upward slab faces, sea_cap on upward upper-pillar cap faces. Lower ornamental panels retain the stone default.

NB_marine_breakwater.notes: Existing low slab and two block-wall segments only: concrete wall body, base underside/lowest sides, deck on slab top, cap on upward wall tops. No separate exposed aggregate geometry was identified; no aggregate mask is invented.
